build_optimizer: build a PyTorch optimizer from timm or torch.optim with model parameters and learning rate
build_lr_scheduler: build a learning rate scheduler from timm or torch.optim.lr_scheduler for a given optimizer
parse_params: parse a comma-separated string of optimizer or scheduler parameters into a dictionary
restart_from_checkpoint: restart a training run by loading model state dict and run variables from a checkpoint file
test_optim_module: test the optim module by parsing params, building an optimizer, and building a cosine learning rate scheduler
